title: The appetitive part divided into divine, natural, and fleshly
english: This appetitive part is itself divided into three: divine, natural, and fleshly, which is the diabolical. The divine kind is loving God; the natural kind is loving what is according to nature; and the fleshly kind is loving what is contrary to nature. For example, marriage is according to nature, while fornication and things like it are contrary to nature. I found this in another source.

title: The soul's five powers, starting with intellect
english: The soul has five powers: intellect, discursive thought, opinion, imagination, and sense perception. The intellect is the soul's intellectual sense perception, by which it can see things directly, without investigations.

orientation: The treatise has just finished dividing the appetitive part into three kinds and now begins listing the soul's five powers, starting with the intellect.

title: Definitions of the soul's remaining powers
english: Discursive thought is a power of the soul by which it can know matters through a syllogism. It is called discursive thought because it opens a certain way. Opinion is a power of the soul by which it knows matters without a cause. Imagination is a power of the non-rational soul. Sense perception is a power of the soul capable of apprehending material things.
